hints.title: Key Insight and Observation
hints.text: In one operation, we can add or subtract x from any cell.

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy and State
hints.text: All elements must have the same remainder when divided by x; otherwise, equalizing them is impossible.

hints.title: Optimal Boundary and Processing
hints.text: Sort all grid elements and choose the median value to minimize the sum of absolute deviations.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Flattens and sorts m * n elements, then sums L1 distances to the median in linear time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Testing every potential target value takes quadratic O((m * n)^2) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Stores flattened array of length m * n.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Identifies median as the optimal L1 target and verifies modulo feasibility.
